name: Jonathan Horton

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Mary Tuthill (b. 1687, d. 1780), daughter of John Tuthill Jr & Mehitable Wells; six children Mary, Eliphaz, Mehitable, Azariah, Lazarus, Ambrose (b. 1708-20).

relationships.evidence: (mother Bethia Wells) Horton Genealogy: Capt. Jonathan Horton m. c.1672 Bethia Wells, dau. of William Wells; child no. 7 'Jonathan, born 23d December, 1683, married Mary Tuthill'

bioAdditions: Son of Capt. Jonathan Horton (first captain of Suffolk County's first cavalry company) and Bethia, daughter of William Wells (S2). So he is himself John's blood cousin: William Wells -> Bethia -> Jonathan, 1st cousin 10 times removed (and 1C11R via Barnabas Horton if the Rachel Browne line holds). His wife Mary Tuthill is John's 9th-great-grandaunt.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Two compiled genealogies (Akerly, Horton) agree on parentage, marriage and dates.
